title: Freight Claim Authorization Form
subtitle: Freight Claim Intake: bounds the decision, conditions, and expiry.
description: Freight Claim Authorization Form binds claimed shipment, affected goods, loss amount, supporting documents, mitigation, and investigation to a named transport decision, commercial or operating limit, effective time, and the claimant / settlement authority's confirmation. The freight claims coordinator records the requested Freight Claim Intake action and keeps any variance outside the granted authority.
use_case: Use Freight Claim Authorization Form at origin, transit custody points, destination, inspection location, and evidence repository. Reconcile applicable Freight Claim Intake requirements with the load, carrier, rate, claim, equipment, document, or inventory boundary that applies. Capture the claimant / settlement authority's approval, counteroffer, hold, or decline, then reauthorize any change to claimed shipment, affected goods, loss amount, supporting documents, mitigation, and investigation.

sections.guidance: Stop Freight Claim Intake at the stated boundary and obtain renewed consent for a material variance.

blocks.guidance: Stop normal processing when claim identity, determinable amount, evidence preservation, notice, or authorized investigation remains unresolved. Protect claimed shipment, affected goods, loss amount, supporting documents, mitigation, and investigation; record the Freight Claim Intake notification and obtain renewed authorization from claimant / settlement authority before continuing.
